# Memtest86+ 9.00

`memtest86plus.efi` is the unmodified `mt86p_900_x86_64` file from the
[official binaries archive](https://memtest.org/download/v9.00/mt86plus_9.00.binaries.zip).
The matching [upstream source archive](https://memtest.org/download/v9.00/mt86plus_9.00.src.zip)
is included as `memtest86plus-9.00-source.zip`, along with its GPL license.
Both upstream archives were checked against the
[published SHA-256 sums](https://memtest.org/download/v9.00/sha256sum.txt).
